roles.title: Software Development Engineer
roles.summary: Building AI-powered pricing and costing intelligence for logistics.

highlights.title: AI-powered rate card comparison engine
highlights.text: Developed an **AI-powered rate card comparison engine** that summarises repriced rates, newly added entries and key pricing changes between vendor revisions — reducing manual auditing effort and minimising missed pricing discrepancies.

highlights.title: AI-assisted rounding-weight pricing
highlights.text: Built an **AI-assisted rounding-weight pricing solution** for vendors with highly inconsistent pricing formats, closing a costing gap impacting nearly **half a million** in transaction value for large enterprise customers.

highlights.title: Re-architecting the costing platform for unit & UOM pricing
highlights.text: Re-architected the logistics costing platform to support both **unit-based** and **UOM-based** pricing models, redesigning rate-card ingestion, costing and auditing while staying compatible with existing vendor contracts.

roles.title: Software Development Engineer II
roles.summary: ERP transformation through event-driven microservices and Saga orchestration.

highlights.title: Event-driven microservices for the ERP transformation
highlights.text: Architected **event-driven microservices** on **Kafka** with retry and DLQ mechanisms for the ERP transformation, building scalable order-cancellation and inventory-recovery modules.

highlights.title: A reusable Saga orchestrator
highlights.text: Built a reusable **Saga Orchestrator** for multi-step async workflows with rollback, improving cross-service consistency through robust retry mechanisms.

highlights.title: Revamping the order detail view
highlights.text: Revamped the **order detail view** using React.js, GraphQL and REST APIs, integrating KYC and seller incentive claims behind a structured release plan.

highlights.title: Automating finance operations: 9.8% → 1.2% manual effort
highlights.text: **Automated finance operations**, reducing manual effort from **9.8% to 1.2%** and improving auto-procurement throughput.

roles.title: Software Development Engineer I
roles.summary: Notification systems, fulfilment tooling and legacy optimisation.

highlights.title: A queue-driven notification service at 50K+/day
highlights.text: Developed a **queue-driven notification service** for non-invoiced orders, orchestrating WhatsApp, SMS and email reminders at a peak of **50,000+ notifications/day**.

highlights.title: Fixing a two-year-old duplicate-barcode bug
highlights.text: Resolved a **2-year-old production bug** of duplicate barcodes per order by tracing it to a lagging Kafka message queue.

highlights.title: Optimising 500+ legacy Rails background jobs
highlights.text: Optimised **500+ legacy Rails background processes**, improving query performance, memory usage and Kafka consumer stability.

highlights.title: Item inwarding & vendor procurement at 99.9% accuracy
highlights.text: Built **item inwarding and vendor procurement workflows** with **99.9% intake accuracy**, improving inventory operations and ERP data consistency.

highlights.title: Delay-reason upload pipeline with pre-signed S3 URLs
highlights.text: Developed a **delay-reason upload pipeline** using pre-signed S3 URLs, triggering downstream delivery updates through Kafka for accurate ETA adjustments.

highlights.title: A barcode-verification picklist dashboard
highlights.text: Built a **React.js picklist dashboard** for barcode verification before invoicing, handling **20% of orders** and improving fulfilment accuracy.

highlights.title: CL Connect — a social-gifting proof of concept
highlights.text: Created **CL Connect**, a social-gifting POC for wishlist sharing using React.js and Node.js.
